_comment: C0-15 mlx bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（llama-cpp/ollama），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [openai-agents-sdk]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: MLX-native format + HF conversion (the mlx-community ecosystem); GGUF convertible (mlx-community has a conversion line); the model list rolls with the community, not inventoried item by item.
axes.runtime: A native tensor framework for the Apple-silicon (M-series) unified-memory architecture; mlx-lm is the official LLM runtime line ("Run LLMs with MLX" repo description, direct-fetched). GitHub mlx 28,877★ / mlx-lm 7,426★ (API verified 2026-10-21).
axes.local_files: Fully local: models and outputs live in your own environment; no official cloud line seen — Apple provides no companion cloud-inference line (no statement seen).
axes.background: mlx_lm.server provides an OpenAI-compatible service line; details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: mlx-lm includes a tool-calling line; MCP not verified item by item.
axes.context: Context is set by parameters; KV-cache quantization is in the mlx-lm docs line, details not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: A local process with no account system; CLI/service-line authentication configured by the user (mlx_lm.server details not verified item by item).
axes.fit: Fits: Apple-silicon machines wanting native performance (the unified-memory dividend), fine-tuning on the Mac (mlx-lm carries a fine-tuning line). Does not fit: non-Apple hardware; wanting one cross-platform stack (llama.cpp covers more ground).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the local-endpoint and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no runner-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The full mlx-community model list and conversion quality (a community ecosystem, not inventoried item by item)
- Details of mlx_lm.server's OpenAI-compatibility surface (not verified item by item)
- MCP support status (no official statement verified)
related: The root of the cross-platform GGUF route; LM Studio wraps both lines into one app.
On the Mac, Ollama is smoother for out-of-the-box model acquisition; MLX's value is Apple-silicon native performance and same-stack fine-tuning.
